verdict.rationale: Anytype documents a block editor with headings (toggled headings, auto-generated TOC), slash commands (/toc, /latex) for keyboard-driven insertion, nestable and column blocks, and file/media handling. A community user confirms a decent editor with code highlighting. Callouts and in-page tables are never evidenced, and media embedding is only implied by the files-and-media page. Missing for 10: callout blocks, table blocks, explicit embedded-media blocks, first-party code-block documentation, keyboard-shortcut/speed evidence.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can write and format notes with headings, callouts, tables, code blocks, and embedded media in a fast keyboard-driven editor
